header.name: Data Mining
header.description: Data mining aims at finding the useful patterns in large data sets. Interest in the field is motivated by the growth of computerized data collection due to ubiquity of Internet enabled devices. This course will cover a set of techniques designed to be used for finding interesting patterns from the data. The techniques include classification, clustering, association rule minin and sequence mining. Students will learn and use the open source R statistical software, see http://www.r-project.org, and machine learning packages such as Weka in this course.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to discuss basic applications, concepts and techniques of data mining such as association rules mining, classification, clustering and sequence mining.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to use data mining software (Weka, R etc.) to solve practical problemsrelated to association rules mining, classification, clustering and sequence mining.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to analyze the performance of different data mining techniques.

lecture_topics: Exploratory data analysis on numeric and categorical attributes
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: One programming assignment to introduce the students to basics of pre-processing and analyzing a small dataset using R. One assignment containing practice questions on frequent pattern mining .

lecture_topics: Exploratory data analysis on high dimensional data
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: A programming assignment to apply PCA/SVD techniques on real dataset.
A programming assignment to apply different classifiers as well as evaluate their performance.
A programming assignment on hierarchical/density based clustering.
